name: Asana

One request, no retry, token exchange, refresh, 429 recovery or automatic replay. Page offset/path/uri are return-only; caller can explicitly supply offset on the same operation and scope. Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. definitions.documentation: POST https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/projects/{project_gid}/addMembers. External PAT or OAuth access token; exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken/apiKey or ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="ASANA ADD-MEMBERS-PROJECT", $retries=0. One request, no retry, token exchange, refresh, 429 recovery or automatic replay. Page offset/path/uri are return-only; caller can explicitly supply offset on the same operation and scope. Batch Update Tasks accepts 1 to 10 independent typed task updates, executes in parallel without order/dependency guarantees, and returns status plus sanitized task only; failed private bodies/headers are discarded. Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch, reads, decoding and return; strict UTF8/UTF16; cleanup is nonblocking. definitions.documentation: POST https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/projects/{project_gid}/removeFollowers. External PAT or OAuth access token; exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken/apiKey or ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="ASANA REMOVE-FOLLOWERS-PROJECT", $retries=0. One request, no retry, token exchange, refresh, 429 recovery or automatic replay. Page offset/path/uri are return-only; caller can explicitly supply offset on the same operation and scope. Batch Update Tasks accepts 1 to 10 independent typed task updates, executes in parallel without order/dependency guarantees, and returns status plus sanitized task only; failed private bodies/headers are discarded. Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch, reads, decoding and return; strict UTF8/UTF16; cleanup is nonblocking. definitions.documentation: GET https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/tasks. External PAT or OAuth access token; exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken/apiKey or ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. One request, no retry, token exchange, refresh, 429 recovery or automatic replay. Page offset/path/uri are return-only; caller can explicitly supply offset on the same operation and scope. Batch Update Tasks accepts 1 to 10 independent typed task updates, executes in parallel without order/dependency guarantees, and returns status plus sanitized task only; failed private bodies/headers are discarded. Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch, reads, decoding and return; strict UTF8/UTF16; cleanup is nonblocking. definitions.documentation: GET https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/tasks/{task_gid}. External PAT or OAuth access token; exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken/apiKey or ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. One request, no retry, token exchange, refresh, 429 recovery or automatic replay. Page offset/path/uri are return-only; caller can explicitly supply offset on the same operation and scope. Batch Update Tasks accepts 1 to 10 independent typed task updates, executes in parallel without order/dependency guarantees, and returns status plus sanitized task only; failed private bodies/headers are discarded. Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch, reads, decoding and return; strict UTF8/UTF16; cleanup is nonblocking. definitions.name: Asana Create Task
definitions.description: Asana Create Task
definitions.documentation: POST https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/tasks. External PAT or OAuth access token; exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken/apiKey or ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="ASANA CREATE-TASK", $retries=0. One request, no retry, token exchange, refresh, 429 recovery or automatic replay. Page offset/path/uri are return-only; caller can explicitly supply offset on the same operation and scope. Batch Update Tasks accepts 1 to 10 independent typed task updates, executes in parallel without order/dependency guarantees, and returns status plus sanitized task only; failed private bodies/headers are discarded. Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch, reads, decoding and return; strict UTF8/UTF16; cleanup is nonblocking. definitions.name: Asana Update Task
definitions.description: Asana Update Task
definitions.documentation: PUT https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/tasks/{task_gid}. External PAT or OAuth access token; exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken/apiKey or ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="ASANA UPDATE-TASK", $retries=0. One request, no retry, token exchange, refresh, 429 recovery or automatic replay. Page offset/path/uri are return-only; caller can explicitly supply offset on the same operation and scope. Batch Update Tasks accepts 1 to 10 independent typed task updates, executes in parallel without order/dependency guarantees, and returns status plus sanitized task only; failed private bodies/headers are discarded. Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch, reads, decoding and return; strict UTF8/UTF16; cleanup is nonblocking. Sources: https://developers.asana.com/reference/rest-api-reference https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Asana/openapi/master/defs/asana_oas.yaml https://developers.asana.com/docs/batch-requests https://developers.asana.com/docs/pagination https://developers.asana.com/docs/personal-access-token

definitions.documentation: DELETE https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/tasks/{task_gid}. External PAT or OAuth access token; exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken/apiKey or ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="ASANA DELETE-TASK", $retries=0. One request, no retry, token exchange, refresh, 429 recovery or automatic replay. Page offset/path/uri are return-only; caller can explicitly supply offset on the same operation and scope. Batch Update Tasks accepts 1 to 10 independent typed task updates, executes in parallel without order/dependency guarantees, and returns status plus sanitized task only; failed private bodies/headers are discarded. Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch, reads, decoding and return; strict UTF8/UTF16; cleanup is nonblocking. definitions.documentation: GET https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/tasks/{task_gid}/subtasks. External PAT or OAuth access token; exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken/apiKey or ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. One request, no retry, token exchange, refresh, 429 recovery or automatic replay. Page offset/path/uri are return-only; caller can explicitly supply offset on the same operation and scope. Batch Update Tasks accepts 1 to 10 independent typed task updates, executes in parallel without order/dependency guarantees, and returns status plus sanitized task only; failed private bodies/headers are discarded. Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch, reads, decoding and return; strict UTF8/UTF16; cleanup is nonblocking. definitions.documentation: POST https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/tasks/{task_gid}/subtasks. External PAT or OAuth access token; exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken/apiKey or ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="ASANA CREATE-SUBTASK", $retries=0. One request, no retry, token exchange, refresh, 429 recovery or automatic replay. Page offset/path/uri are return-only; caller can explicitly supply offset on the same operation and scope. Batch Update Tasks accepts 1 to 10 independent typed task updates, executes in parallel without order/dependency guarantees, and returns status plus sanitized task only; failed private bodies/headers are discarded. Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch, reads, decoding and return; strict UTF8/UTF16; cleanup is nonblocking. External PAT or OAuth access token; exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken/apiKey or ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="ASANA SET-TASK-PARENT", $retries=0. One request, no retry, token exchange, refresh, 429 recovery or automatic replay. Page offset/path/uri are return-only; caller can explicitly supply offset on the same operation and scope. Batch Update Tasks accepts 1 to 10 independent typed task updates, executes in parallel without order/dependency guarantees, and returns status plus sanitized task only; failed private bodies/headers are discarded. Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch, reads, decoding and return; strict UTF8/UTF16; cleanup is nonblocking. definitions.description: Asana Add Task Followers
definitions.documentation: POST https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/tasks/{task_gid}/addFollowers. External PAT or OAuth access token; exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken/apiKey or ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="ASANA ADD-TASK-FOLLOWERS", $retries=0. One request, no retry, token exchange, refresh, 429 recovery or automatic replay. Page offset/path/uri are return-only; caller can explicitly supply offset on the same operation and scope. Batch Update Tasks accepts 1 to 10 independent typed task updates, executes in parallel without order/dependency guarantees, and returns status plus sanitized task only; failed private bodies/headers are discarded. Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch, reads, decoding and return; strict UTF8/UTF16; cleanup is nonblocking. definitions.documentation: POST https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/tasks/{task_gid}/removeFollowers. External PAT or OAuth access token; exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken/apiKey or ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="ASANA REMOVE-TASK-FOLLOWERS", $retries=0. One request, no retry, token exchange, refresh, 429 recovery or automatic replay. Page offset/path/uri are return-only; caller can explicitly supply offset on the same operation and scope. Batch Update Tasks accepts 1 to 10 independent typed task updates, executes in parallel without order/dependency guarantees, and returns status plus sanitized task only; failed private bodies/headers are discarded. Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch, reads, decoding and return; strict UTF8/UTF16; cleanup is nonblocking. definitions.documentation: GET https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/projects/{project_gid}/tasks. External PAT or OAuth access token; exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken/apiKey or ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. One request, no retry, token exchange, refresh, 429 recovery or automatic replay. Page offset/path/uri are return-only; caller can explicitly supply offset on the same operation and scope. Batch Update Tasks accepts 1 to 10 independent typed task updates, executes in parallel without order/dependency guarantees, and returns status plus sanitized task only; failed private bodies/headers are discarded. Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch, reads, decoding and return; strict UTF8/UTF16; cleanup is nonblocking. definitions.description: Asana Delete Section
definitions.documentation: DELETE https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/sections/{section_gid}. External PAT or OAuth access token; exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken/apiKey or ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="ASANA DELETE-SECTION", $retries=0. One request, no retry, token exchange, refresh, 429 recovery or automatic replay. Page offset/path/uri are return-only; caller can explicitly supply offset on the same operation and scope. Batch Update Tasks accepts 1 to 10 independent typed task updates, executes in parallel without order/dependency guarantees, and returns status plus sanitized task only; failed private bodies/headers are discarded. Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch, reads, decoding and return; strict UTF8/UTF16; cleanup is nonblocking. definitions.documentation: GET https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/custom_fields/{custom_field_gid}. External PAT or OAuth access token; exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken/apiKey or ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. One request, no retry, token exchange, refresh, 429 recovery or automatic replay. Page offset/path/uri are return-only; caller can explicitly supply offset on the same operation and scope. Batch Update Tasks accepts 1 to 10 independent typed task updates, executes in parallel without order/dependency guarantees, and returns status plus sanitized task only; failed private bodies/headers are discarded. Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch, reads, decoding and return; strict UTF8/UTF16; cleanup is nonblocking. definitions.documentation: GET https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/teams/{team_gid}/projects. External PAT or OAuth access token; exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken/apiKey or ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. One request, no retry, token exchange, refresh, 429 recovery or automatic replay. Page offset/path/uri are return-only; caller can explicitly supply offset on the same operation and scope. Batch Update Tasks accepts 1 to 10 independent typed task updates, executes in parallel without order/dependency guarantees, and returns status plus sanitized task only; failed private bodies/headers are discarded. Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch, reads, decoding and return; strict UTF8/UTF16; cleanup is nonblocking. definitions.description: Asana Add Team User
definitions.documentation: POST https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/teams/{team_gid}/addUser. External PAT or OAuth access token; exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken/apiKey or ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="ASANA ADD-TEAM-USER", $retries=0. One request, no retry, token exchange, refresh, 429 recovery or automatic replay. Page offset/path/uri are return-only; caller can explicitly supply offset on the same operation and scope. Batch Update Tasks accepts 1 to 10 independent typed task updates, executes in parallel without order/dependency guarantees, and returns status plus sanitized task only; failed private bodies/headers are discarded. Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch, reads, decoding and return; strict UTF8/UTF16; cleanup is nonblocking. Sources: https://developers.asana.com/reference/rest-api-reference https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Asana/openapi/master/defs/asana_oas.yaml https://developers.asana.com/docs/batch-requests https://developers.asana.com/docs/pagination https://developers.asana.com/docs/personal-access-token

Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. definitions.code: function bounded(v){const stack=[[v,0,false]],active=new Set();let count=0;while(stack.length){const [x,d,exit]=stack.pop();if(exit){active.delete(x);continue;}if(d>90||++count>200000)throw Error('Value complexity bound');if(x===null||typeof x==='string'||typeof x==='boolean')continue;if(typeof x==='number'&&Number.isFinite(x))continue;if(!x||typeof x!=='object'||active.has(x)||!Array.isArray(x)&&![Object.prototype,null].includes(Object.getPrototypeOf(x)))throw Error('Finite acyclic JSON required');active.add(x);stack.push([x,d,true]);for(const y of Array.isArray(x)?x:Object.values(x))stack.push([y,d+1,false]);}if(Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(v))>1048576)throw Error('Value exceeds 1 MiB');return v;}const rest=structuredClone(bounded(inputs.value)),index=inputs.index??0,count=rest.length;if(!Number.isSafeInteger(index)||index<0||(count?index>=count:index!==0))throw Error('List index outside bounds');const out={rest,index,count};if(count)out.item=rest.splice(index,1)[0];return out;

definitions.name: Asana Batch Update Tasks
definitions.description: Asana Batch Update Tasks
definitions.documentation: POST https://app.asana.com/api/1.0/batch. External PAT or OAuth access token; exact RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken/apiKey or ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation="ASANA BATCH-UPDATE-TASKS", $retries=0. One request, no retry, token exchange, refresh, 429 recovery or automatic replay. Page offset/path/uri are return-only; caller can explicitly supply offset on the same operation and scope. Batch Update Tasks accepts 1 to 10 independent typed task updates, executes in parallel without order/dependency guarantees, and returns status plus sanitized task only; failed private bodies/headers are discarded. Partial success must be reconciled manually. Known response fields are projected to pinned schemas; opt_fields selects provider expansion. Decimal IDs remain strings and fractional/unsafe JSON number tokens become exact decimal text. Limits: 100 rows/page, 10 batch actions, 512 KiB input, 1 MiB output, depth35, 16384 nonempty chunks. Total Date.now deadline starts before profile/secrets and guards dispatch, reads, decoding and return; strict UTF8/UTF16; cleanup is nonblocking. Sources: https://developers.asana.com/reference/rest-api-reference https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Asana/openapi/master/defs/asana_oas.yaml https://developers.asana.com/docs/batch-requests https://developers.asana.com/docs/pagination https://developers.asana.com/docs/personal-access-token
